text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl got hurt, so I brought 
her to the nurse's office.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Don't worry. It's nothing to make a fuss 
over."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Look! Look!! Well, what do you think!!?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Heh... Sharp as ever, wouldn't you say?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Something like this won't put an end to my 
potential. Come on, let's go train!
choice_data_list: If it's just rehab, I can handle it...!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: ...Phew... I see. So that is your choice.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...I understand. That dance earlier was 
the absolute best I could do right now. If 
that's what you thought after seeing it...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Until it's fully healed, there's nothing 
to do but take it easy.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, leave it to me! Let's go explore my 
potential!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It seems... I exceeded my limits and 
danced with a bit too much passion... 
don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The effects of the injury were severe, 
leaving Seeking the Pearl no choice but to 
take some time off to rest.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Pheeeew! Not a single problem at all!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! As long as your heart doesn't 
yield, nothing in this world is 
impossible!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl brilliantly showcased 
her potential and went on to make a smooth 
comeback.
